note: Both ends are now tagged. Client: tftpPeer.read fails the test on any client packet whose source address or port differs from the RRQ's, so every client test checks that the client keeps its TID. TestRFC1350ClientKeepsItsTID also requires that nothing more reaches the request port for 300 ms once the server answered from its own TID. Server: TestListenTFTPLoopbackRoundTrip and TestRFC1350ServerChoosesOneTIDForTheTransfer are unchanged in substance; handleRRQ and runTransfer changed only by identifier renames.
